thread:
Nina Park: Heads-up from AE: Customer Plover wants a per-route "priority lane" add-on. They want to buy a pool of "Priority Credits" monthly, allocate them to routes, and have unused credits roll to the next month.

Ravi Shah: Sounds like a packaging + billing ask. Do they need hard SLOs or just better performance when credits are available?

Nina Park: They want two modes: (1) Soft-priority: requests consume credits and get faster scheduling; (2) Guaranteed-priority: reserved tokens with SLA and blackout protection. They prefer soft for hosted initially.

Eve Thompson: Eng perspective: implementable as per-route credit counters + scheduling weights. Rolling over unused credits adds state and billing reconciliation. ETA for soft-priority MVP: ~1.5w. Guaranteed-priority maps to Dedicated or reserved allocation and is a larger effort.

Ben Carter: Pricing note: propose tiered monthly credit bundles: 50k, 250k, 1M credits. Add-on price per credit reduces with volume. Also define transfer rules between routes and rollover cap (e.g., up to 2x monthly allotment).

legal-bot: Flag: rollover and transfer create accounting obligations and may impact revenue recognition. Need a legal/finance-approved term for "Priority Credit" as an add-on SKU and a clause for unused-credit rollover limits.

Ravi Shah: UX: in Console, add a "Priority Credits" ledger with a per-route allocation panel and timeline showing consumption + rollover. Allow admins to set auto-allocate rules from a global pool.

Eve Thompson: Operational concerns: credit exhaustion behavior must be clear: when credits are gone, fall back to default routing (no throttling rejection). Also need metrics: credits-consumed-per-route, credits-remaining, queue-latency-by-priority. ops-bot: NOTE: feature will require new Prometheus metrics and a small tracer tag for priority lanes.

Nina Park: Launch criteria idea:
- Pilot with 1 customer (Plover) for 6 weeks
- Soft-priority MVP with console ledger and rollover cap support
- Billing SKU + internal pricing table published
- Docs and runbook for ops and account team

Ben Carter: Commercial: offer pilot discount (20%) and require a 3-month minimum paid commitment for pilot credits. That helps revenue predictability and reduces churn risk.

legal-bot: Also require an opt-in addendum that states rollover caps and non-refundable nature of consumed credits.

Eve Thompson: Implementation checklist:
- Runtime: scheduler weight hook, credit consumption hook (1d)
- Billing: ledger entries + monthly reconciliation job (3d)
- Console: allocation UI + ledger view (3d)
- Metrics/runbook (2d)

Ravi Shah: Product risk: complexity. Suggest calling it an "experimental add-on" and hide behind feature-flag. Only the Console owners and billing team can enable for accounts.

Nina Park: Action items: Nina -> sync AE + get exact credit volume ask from Plover; Ben -> draft price bands and pilot discount term; Eve -> start design doc and list infra deps; Ravi -> console mockups + feature flag plan; Legal -> prepare addendum draft. Decide pilot terms by next Tue.

Ravi Shah: I'll post the Console mockups in this thread when ready.

Eve Thompson: I'll open the internal RFC and tag runtime/billing teams.

Nina Park: Thanks all. Small follow-up: is everyone comfortable with 2x rollover cap suggestion?

Ben Carter: Fine with 2x cap for pilot.
